text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A defeat against TM Opera O. Air Shakur 
believed this loss was no fluke, and that 
an endless losing streak was on the 
horizon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Meisho Doto's abilities 
haven't reached Opera O's, nor those of 
the generation above her. The true nature 
of the ceiling slowing her growth isâ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Holding back against TM Opera O. It 
turned out that her deep respect for 
someone she admired so much was the reason 
why.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she can't view her idol as a rival, 
there is no future for her. Her mindset 
must be changed before her next race, the 
Japan Cup.
